In October, October month of 2022, I had a lot of pain in the neck area.
Pain in the neck area, headaches, vomiting, and also back pain. That is, pain in the middle, also called neck pain
which comes from the back, it was unbearable pain. One day my mother brought a medicine.
After that, Bolinio or Gell, she brought a tube. After that, I would consume it completely for one hour or half an hour
that much of a pain it was. The pain was so much that I had it in
the neck area, morning or night, I had no sleep, nothing at all. By October, at night,
sometimes I would see the contents of Kreupasanam. Whenever I saw it, I would do light candle prayer
online, and I had also taken the covenant online. At that time, I told Mother, “Mother,
if you remove this pain for me, I will come here and testify no matter what.” That’s what I said. So one day,
by mid-October, the pain in the neck and back I had, as well as headaches, vomiting.
It was unbearable. Even the severe pain that started didn’t go away the next day, so my mother and my elder brother took me to the hospital.
At the hospital, when they did a blood test, they said it was a normal infection found in blood, and the blood count was slightly high or low. So they admitted me.
They admitted me and said that because of the back pain, there might be some complaint with the disc,
which would get better. They told us that we could do physiotherapy and other treatments. So they admitted me,
and for five days I took antibiotics and did physiotherapy for four days. On the last day, that is, the day of discharge, when I took physiotherapy, I couldn’t even stand upright.
That is, I couldn’t see anything with my eyes. I didn’t know anything. I couldn’t see forward at
all. Then the doctor came and discharged me. I didn’t tell them how much difficulty I was in.
When I reached home, my elder brother asked me, “Hey, do you feel something in your eyes? Why are you eyes like this?” Then
my left eye had shifted to one side.
That is, I couldn’t see anything with that eye. There was no other problem. Within five days, I had completely lost vision in that eye. I didn’t know the reason.
By the next day, my father and mother again took me to the hospital.
Until that time, for 21 years, I never had any problem with my eyes or vision. That day, when I got out
of the vehicle, I couldn’t see with either eye. I got out of the vehicle and went to the hospital, and the doctor
seriously examined me and referred me to an eye specialist. The doctor said there was an infection in the optic nerve and that it needed serious attention.

I was in so much pain that I couldn’t even go for an X-Ray on the hospital bed, sitting in a wheelchair. I couldn’t stand or walk at all.
